cases.description: Happy path – valid JSON string, JSON input format, no customizer. All schema validators run and return an empty error set.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> contains a parsing error message (e.g., "Invalid JSON: Unexpected token" )
cases.description: Malformed JSON triggers a parsing exception inside `deserialize`; the method should catch it and return a ValidationMessage describing the JSON syntax error.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown with message containing "input must not be null"
cases.description: Branch where the `input` argument is null – the method validates arguments and throws IllegalArgumentException before any deserialization.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> contains a parsing error (empty JSON document)
cases.description: Empty string is not a valid JSON document; `deserialize` fails and the method returns a parsing error message.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown with message containing "inputFormat must not be null"
cases.description: Branch where `inputFormat` argument is null – method should validate and throw IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> contains a required‑property error for "name" (because customizer set strict mode)
cases.description: Custom ExecutionContextCustomizer modifies the ExecutionContext (e.g., enables strict mode) causing a required‑property validator to fire. Verifies that the customizer is applied.

cases.expected: RuntimeException is propagated (the same exception thrown by the customizer)
cases.description: Branch where the provided ExecutionContextCustomizer throws an unchecked exception; the method should not swallow it.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> is empty (URL‑decoded JSON is valid)
cases.description: When InputFormat is URL_ENCODED, `deserialize` uses URLDecoder; valid URL‑encoded JSON should be decoded correctly and pass validation.
Branch where URL decoding fails due to malformed percent‑encoding, causing `deserialize` to throw UnsupportedEncodingException which should be propagated.
YAML input format – a valid YAML document that maps to the same JSON structure used in the happy‑path test. The method should deserialize the YAML correctly and return an empty error set.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> contains a parsing error message (e.g., "Invalid JSON: Unexpected token")
cases.description: URL‑encoded string that decodes to malformed JSON (missing value for "age"). After URL decoding, `deserialize` should fail and the method must return a parsing‑error ValidationMessage.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> contains a type‑error message (expected object, found array)
cases.description: JSON array input – the schema (which expects a JSON object with required properties) receives an array. The validator should report a type‑mismatch error.

Custom ExecutionContextCustomizer disables strict‑mode (or required‑property enforcement). The input lacks the required "name" property, but because strict mode is turned off the validator should not report an error.

cases.expected: Set<ValidationMessage> contains exactly one message – the first validation error encountered (e.g., required‑property "name" missing)
cases.description: Custom ExecutionContextCustomizer enables fail‑fast mode. The JSON is missing the required "name" property and also has a type error for "age". With fail‑fast enabled the validator should stop after the first error, so the result set contains only that single message.

group: JsonSchema.validate(String, InputFormat, ExecutionContextCustomizer) - exception edge cases

cases.expected: AssertionError is propagated (the same error thrown by the customizer)
cases.description: ExecutionContextCustomizer throws an AssertionError (subclass of Error). The validate method must not catch Errors, so the AssertionError should bubble up unchanged.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException is propagated (the same exception thrown by the customizer)
cases.description: ExecutionContextCustomizer throws a checked‑runtime exception (IllegalStateException). The method should let the exception propagate without wrapping.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown with message containing "input must not be null"
cases.description: Even though the customizer would throw a RuntimeException, argument validation occurs first. The method must detect the null input and throw IllegalArgumentException before invoking the customizer.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown with message containing "inputFormat must not be null"
cases.description: Argument validation should also reject a null InputFormat even when the input string itself is valid.
